popover.description: Minimal permissions for the S13 popover window. Scoped to that one window, and granting ONLY the event channel it needs to receive UiSnapshot pushes. Window manipulation, filesystem, shell and every other core plugin are deliberately absent: an XSS in a page that renders unauthenticated agent names must have as little to reach for as possible (WINDOW_UI_PLAN.md W-D11 layer 3). Hiding and quitting go through the app's own ui_close_window / ui_quit commands instead of core:window permissions.
